title: Configure Android SDK, Flutter toolchain, and verify debug build

assignee: AI agent with human approval required only for license acceptance or consequential build decisions

No React, Android production, Flutter product feature, application ID, package, dependency, or signing configuration is changed.

Run flutter build apk --debug in flutter_app.
Verify java -version, adb version, sdkmanager package list, and adb devices.
